title: costus speciosus var. hirsutus
intro: Costus speciosus var. hirsutus, commonly known as the hairy variegated costus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Costaceae. It is a perennial plant native to tropical regions of Asia and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The hairy variegated costus is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating fever, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenes and alkaloids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antipyretic, and spasmolytic effects.
